subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.

The rope __gave way__ while the workmen were hauling up the iron pillar.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e. **'Snapped'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** most appropriate** meaning of the idiom "gave way" in the given sentence is 2) snapped.
 
• **In this context,** "gave way"** means** that the rope suddenly broke or snapped.(टूट गई)
 
• The workmen were pulling or hauling up the iron pillar, but the rope couldn't withstand the pressure and broke, causing the pillar to fall or drop.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:*** 'Snapped'.***
